name: synthetic-groups-ok
description: SYNTHETIC chain for vela-breakout#groups: GET /groups returns the rankable groups (id, name, signal, meaning, unit, caveat, usual_window_days); trimmed to 4 of 16 groups. FREE — zero usage. Body is a real Breakout API response captured 2026-10-12 (not via `deno task record`, which needs the API live), trimmed by hand; replace via `deno task record` once a key is provisioned.

groups.name: AI apps
groups.meaning: How many AI tokens an app uses in a week.

groups.name: Agent tools
groups.meaning: How many times a week developers download the code behind an MCP server, a tool an AI agent can use.
groups.caveat: Downloads, not users; servers run only from a hosted address are not counted.

groups.name: Business software
groups.meaning: How widely a piece of software is adopted by the companies on one large business-spend panel, month by month.
groups.caveat: The panel's own adoption score, mostly venture-backed small and mid-size US companies. Not a share of all businesses.

groups.name: Companies hiring
groups.meaning: How many open roles a company lists on its own careers page.
groups.caveat: Roles on the company's own careers page, read about once a week. Not every company lists every role.
